# Background

**Data policy.** All observations here are synthetic. See @fig-first and @eq-linear.

1. **Prepare.** Inspect the inputs.
2. **Compare.** Review the trace and `r sample_count` or `{r} mean(values)`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-first
#| fig-cap: !expr caption_text
#| out-width: 75%
fig("calibration_trace")
```

```{r fig-second, fig.cap='A second trace.'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path("figures", "comparison.pdf"))
```
